review: Both complete pre-edit/revised profiles. Named/related bag, hammer, bedazzled, tote, purse, holding, ring and protection descriptions searched across all 37 dossiers; selected complete relevant paragraphs in S1E07/10, S2E02/05/12, S3E06/07/10 and distinct-ring candidates in S2E01/09 and S3E04/05/11 read. No fresh original ASR/audio, sheets, rulebook, art or map review.
critical_boundaries: Handmade gift by Margaret, not Guild-shop purchase; approximately two-by-one-foot dimensions preserved from old profile
One object up to sixty pounds is stated; hammer storage demonstrates that object, not a tested maximum or generic holding-bag behavior
Wedding hiding place is actual; Ball descriptor Wind Fan/Bag of Hammer Holding retained without invented fan transformation/new test
Evelyn separately buys a general Bag of Holding for javelins; no replacement/enlargement/merged inventory inferred
Last known bearer Evelyn, not a fully inspected epilogue inventory; later generic bags do not identify this one
Ring old-script and stone-metal appearance not independently dated storage age or shared artifact origin
Mental recognition and stated +1 AC/all saves do not prove sentience, soulbinding or full independent protection tests
Koh actually gives ring to Krandal, left middle finger and visible expansion; scale mail temporary ashore
S2E05 sheet/inventory uncertainty does not prove a loss, return or continuing worn state
Cloak Protection, Poison Resistance, Evasion, Free Action, Feather Falling and marriage rings distinct
S3E07 unidentified ring-assisted descent does not establish Evelyn receives this protection ring
Party underwater cutoff historical; no fabricated later transfer, disappearance, destruction or post-finale item inventory
